Implemented `refund(payment, amount, at)` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Rejects non-captured payments with `BillingError("invalid_state", ...)`.
- Validates and rounds the refund amount; rejects non-positive amounts.
- Prevents total refunds from exceeding the captured amount.
- Accumulates `payment.refunded_amount` and sets `payment.status = "refunded"` on full refund.
- Validates `at` as UTC and records an audit event.
- Returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, and additional edge cases (over-refund, zero/negative amounts, non-captured payments) were verified.
